window-1.title: ssh.place — Timelapses
window-1.blurb: Watch a whole day of strangers quietly fighting and collaborating over one 200×60 pixel canvas replay as a GIF — it's a tiny communal folk-art archive made entirely in a terminal, and I think you'll want to go claim a corner of it.

window-2.title: 2026 is the Year of the Zine — Commonplace Zines
window-2.blurb: A tiny independent newsletter making the case that folded, stapled, gloriously imperfect paper is having its moment again — which feels like an engraved invitation for you to start a zine as your next side quest.

window-3.title: Pandan Colada (Mocktail)
window-3.blurb: It's kaya toast and pandan chiffon cake reincarnated as a creamy green tiki drink — zero proof, absurdly photogenic, and exactly the kind of thing you'd make a whole persona shoot around.

window-4.title: 10 Ceramic Table Lamps from Contemporary Pottery Studios
window-4.blurb: One lumpy, hand-thrown ceramic lamp does more for a room than a whole furniture haul, and knowing you, you'll look at these and immediately start googling pottery classes so you can make your own.

window-5.title: Miura, Joo Chiat
window-5.blurb: You have to walk through a three-storey Joo Chiat shophouse full of independent labels before you find this tiny matcha-and-wagashi counter hiding at the back, which makes getting a daifuku feel like a small side quest you completed.
